message.content: {"verdict": "revise", "score": 0.55, "reasons": ["The artifact is incomplete: several required sections are missing (Steps to get quotes and select an MCS-certified installer; Available UK grants and how to apply; FAQ; actionable one-page checklist) and the Simple suitability checklist is cut off mid-sentence.", "Key sections present but truncated: the Simple suitability checklist ends with 'r' and the content terminates abruptly.", "The artifact does not yet include links to the research reference list as requested.", "Does not yet constitute a complete homeowner_explainer.md ready for publication; missing grant application guidance, FAQ, and actionable next-steps checklist."], "guidance": "Revise to produce a complete homeowner_explainer.md. Specifically: 1) finish the Simple suitability checklist and repair any broken sentences. 2) Add a section 'Steps to get quotes and select an MCS-certified installer' with a clear, step-by-step process and a short checklist. 3) Add 'Available UK grants and how to apply' (e.g., Boiler Upgrade Scheme) with eligibility criteria and application steps. 4) Include a concise 'FAQ' section addressing common homeowner questions (costs, efficiency, maintenance, when not to install, noise, grid impacts). 5) Include an 'Actionable one-page checklist for next steps' at the end. 6) Add a 'References / research reference list' section with links. 7) Ensure all figures used are clearly sourced from the research and properly attributed. 8) Deliver the final content as a complete Markdown document named homeowner_explainer.md with proper headings, bullets, callout tips, and links."}
